parameters.name: ArtifactType
parameters.description:
The type of the artifact. Default value: AcrImage. Valid values:

*   HelmChart: Helm chart image.
*   AcrImage: container image.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-acr-image-repositories --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --repo-name wordpress --artifact-type AcrImage --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListAcrImageRepositories --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU=' --ArtifactType AcrImage --MaxResults 20 --RepoName wordpress
